literal: Among all rare things, the rarest indeed is, great people, cherishing, as one's own, securing.
translation: Of all rare blessings, the rarest of all is to cherish great people and secure them as one's own kin.
modern: அடைவதற்கரிய நன்மைகள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் மிகவும் அரிய நன்மை, பெரியவர்களைப் போற்றி அவர்களைத் நமக்குச் சுற்றத்தாராக ஆக்கிக் கொள்வதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme value of securing the guidance of wise elders. The author compares this to all other rare achievements in life and declares it to be the most difficult and valuable of all. The key words 'பேணி' (cherishing) and 'தமராக் கொளல்' (making them one's own) show that this is not a casual association; it requires active respect, honor, and cultivation to turn wise mentors into close allies.
